jobs.title: Assistant Town Planner / Code Enforcement Officer
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree in planning or a related field plus 3–4 years of related experience. Requires CT land use knowledge, ArcGIS, MS Office, Zoom, a CT driver's license, and CAZEO certification within 2 years.

jobs.title: Technical Support Manager – PropTech & Smart Building Technology
jobs.location: Toronto or Ontario or United States
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years in technical or product support, technical operations, or a related field, including team management, with direct PropTech, smart building, IoT, access control, or property technology experience.

jobs.title: Sr. Urban Planner
jobs.description: Bachelor’s degree in urban planning, architecture, civil engineering, or related field; 6+ years in architecture and engineering with urban planning focus; AutoCAD proficiency preferred; knowledge of zoning and land use regulations.

jobs.title: Urban Planner II
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree in urban planning, architecture, or related field and 2+ years of related experience. AICP certification or architect registration preferred; valid driver's license or site travel ability may be required.

jobs.title: Urban Planner
jobs.location: Tacoma or Seattle or Washington or Oregon or California
jobs.description: Bachelor’s degree in planning, landscape architecture, or equivalent; 3–5 years of professional planning experience; knowledge of planning practices, land-use controls, public engagement, and strong oral, written, and graphic communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Urban Planner
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree, 10+ years planning experience, AICP preferred, strong analytical, communication, community engagement, and project management skills, US work authorization required.

jobs.title: Senior Urban Planner
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree in planning or related field, minimum 5 years planning experience, GIS proficiency, portfolio of planning analyses and maps, strong writing and presentation skills, AICP preferred.

jobs.title: Current Assistant Planner
jobs.description: Requires a high school diploma and two years of community development or planning experience, a bachelor's degree in planning or related field, or equivalent education and experience; valid Idaho driver's license required.

jobs.title: Urban Planner / Designer (Waltham, MA or Denver, CO HYBRID role)
jobs.description: Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years supporting technically oriented community revitalization or economic development projects. Requires Adobe Creative Suite, analytical skills, Excel/R proficiency, communication skills, and willingness to travel.

jobs.title: Regional Planning Technology Analytics & Data (TAD) Lead (10512)
jobs.description: Degree in business, science, supply chain management, or related field; extensive supply chain experience; ERP and advanced planning transformation expertise; analytics, governance, and stakeholder management skills.
